instruction: Cinematic medium shot of a boxing training session in a gym ring. On the left, the woman in the black and orange sports top (R1) holds up a red focus mitt with her right hand, bracing for impact. On the right, the Asian woman in the white sports bra (R2) extends her left arm to land a punch with her black boxing glove against the mitt. The trainer (R1) watches the glove closely with a serious expression, while the boxer (R2) keeps her head down, focused on the strike. The background shows dark hanging punching bags and red boxing ring ropes under cool, dim gym lighting.
elements: R1 holds up a red focus mitt and braces for R2's punch
R2 extends her left arm to punch R1's focus mitt with a black boxing glove
R1 is the trainer watching the incoming glove closely while R2 is the boxer focused on the strike
The red focus mitt is the contact target held by R1
R2's black boxing glove makes contact with the mitt
The scene is a boxing gym ring with hanging punching bags and red ring ropes
